result.title: RVG-Bench: A Benchmark for Reasoning-Driven Audio-Visual Temporal Grounding
result.comment: 42 pages, including appendices. Project page: https://fyrisk.github.io/RVG-Bench/
result.summary: Existing temporal video grounding (TVG) benchmarks primarily focus on localizing target video segments according to descriptive text queries of the visual content. However, real-world queries are more diverse and often require the model to first understand the user's intent before localization, such as finding visual evidence, identifying the cause of an event, or recalling a remembered moment, yet such queries remain largely overlooked. To mitigate this gap, we introduce RVG-Bench, a benchmark for reasoning-driven audio-visual temporal grounding, where every query is constructed such that the target segment can only be identified through reasoning about the query's underlying intent. We carefully construct the benchmark and rigorously verify its data quality to ensure models truly comprehend the audio-visual content. RVG-Bench comprises 1,255 videos and 1,890 query-interval pairs across eight reasoning types. We evaluate 22 models and find that the strongest, Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash, achieves only 49.6 mIoU. Through a series of controlled analyses, including oracle-grounding probes and test-time scaling experiments, we systematically examine where and why current models struggle, providing insights for future model development.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 RVG-Bench，一个面向推理驱动的音视频时序定位基准：查询需先推断用户意图才能定位目标片段，涵盖八类推理、1255 个视频与 1890 个查询-区间对，并评测 22 个模型（最佳仅 49.6 mIoU），辅以 oracle-grounding 探测和测试时扩展分析。
